title: OA TABLE 67 - the horseback bowfire modifiers: the three speed bands with their to-hit penalties, the 30-degree turn limit and the horse-like creatures clause
audit_label: R683 OA horseback bowfire modifiers audit
audit_comment: OA round seventy (capture p. 220): Table 67 - the horseback bowfire modifiers - the three speed bands of the animal with the -1, -3 and -5 to-hit penalties, the cumulative clause, the 30-degree slight-turning limit and the horse-like creatures clause, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA TABLE 67, printed capture p. 220 - the horseback bowfire modifiers round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE GRID: the animal's current movement read as eighths of its normal movement - less than 1/2 the -1, 1/2 to less than 3/4 the -3, 3/4 to maximum speed the -5 - the modifiers cumulative with those for range, weapon versus armor type, etc. THE TURN LIMIT: during the round in which he fires, the character cannot perform maneuvers with his mount except for slight turning - the most 30 degrees to either side of its current direction, sharper turns and maneuvers preventing the bowfire. THE HORSE-LIKE CLAUSE: the firing also performed mounted on any horse-like creature to which the horsemanship proficiency applies. The grid codifies per the R431 calculus

col_comments: the Table 67 band floors in eighths of the animal's normal movement, by band ordinal (print capture p. 220): band 0 the less-than-half floor 0, band 1 the half floor 4, band 2 the three-quarters floor 6 - the printed bands read as eighths: less than 1/2, 1/2 to less than 3/4, 3/4 to maximum speed
